scope: Bounded complete Product owning-capture profile across Types, independent Analyze/Verify, Lower, direct LLVMBuilder and Clang, plus callback Store native cleanup and current-preflight object cache. Not full language1.4 or full section9.1.2 acceptance.
static_review: Types admits only the bounded complete206 Product shape. Child value uses acquire ownership at closure creation; explicit move read-only environments are Fn, complete refill remains FnMut, reachable partial/error exits require FnOnce.
Product ownership slots cover every direct Managed or complete child independently. Nested owned use and capture/source ordering remain actual-instance based; same nominal type does not merge slots.

Analyze independently admits the recursive type and transfers each child CaptureField to its exact local field at Bind and back at End. Verify independently checks one-to-one prefix Bind/End, current field liveness and call mode; it does not use Types/Analyze proof routines.

Captured Product leaves start Incoming in the independent provenance machinery. Bind/capture transfer does not introduce Created. Existing actual leaf transfer, ordinary-call provenance and fresh/give tests remain in the45-case206 suite.
Shared environment writes/takes are rejected. Repeatable entries must restore every retained shell/field debt. Conditional Drop remains idempotent, while a second actual Take is rejected.

Captured direct child contributes one live flag. Drop clears that flag before recursive declaration-order teardown and emits machine GEP/Call events used by both directBuilder and text reference. No extra partial flags are embedded in a complete child.

LLVM flags and Verify callback Store layout count the same direct children and use actual closure definitions. Independent same-capture-type, mixed child/Managed/padding and Store Fn/FnMut executions test distinct runtime values and actual stride.

Lower/LLVM capture admission is separate from the unchanged owning-array, Product Store-element and error-payload gates. Product-internal Store/Closure/owned-array/Sum/borrowed fields remain excluded.
API construction, parse exclusion and object-cache code remain identical to the previously reviewed213 merge. Runtime matrix checks current Verify/current machine preflight even on cache hits.

explicit_scope_limits: Default read-only borrowed Product capture remains Unsupported, matching the previous flat Package implementation boundary. Explicit move read-only Fn and default actual whole/child ownership use are covered; the final implemented_partial status must not claim default borrowing or full section9.1.2.
No Product-internal Store/Closure/owned-array/Sum/borrowed fields; Product itself does not become a Store element, owning-array element or error payload.
Long-term external retention, generalized traits/lending/dyn, async/concurrency/cancellation and full1.4 remain outside this slice.
This review does not establish same-semantics Rust runtime/RSS/maintenance/compiler-speed superiority or a product-level net breakthrough.
